proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/WaitSignal implemented through CE execution paths (new rma_ce/rma launch logic, signal/ack handling, chunked transfers, and CE-side waits), so copy-engine is primary. Enqueue is additionally needed because these APIs add a new task type and planner/plan lifecycle integration (task append, batching, launch preparation, cleanup). Communicator is also substantive due to new capability/config gating and lifecycle wiring (numRmaCtx parsing/defaults/env override, hostRmaSupport computation/reporting, RMA CE init/finalize state and group integration).
